change_note: NativeGateway 0.8.7 eHMI identity & recovery hardening: (1) unify GatewayId and MQTT ClientId into one eHMI field and support persistent online GatewayId modification with safe in-place CaptureBuffer reset; (2) reclaim CaptureBuffer 4-slot dictionary under non-audit runtime by evicting oldest AuditEvents, Associations and inactive TerminalOwners in NG_ConfigSlot; (3) add eHMI Maintenance one-click point-table/baseline reset (GW_Nav=70, SaveReason=7) preserving Broker and GatewayId; (4) fix AckPending/RxStage SaveBroker & Reset deadlock by gating on StoreBusy only.
